Florida healthcare marketing

Healthcare Marketing Agency for Florida Medical Practices, Starting in Miami

We are a Houston-based healthcare marketing and website team serving Florida practices remotely. Our Florida focus begins in Miami, where practices market to a bilingual, multi-city metro and compete with large networks and health systems. This page explains what we offer Florida practices, how specialty and ZIP code affect availability, and which pages to read next.

We do not have a Florida office, and we say so on every Florida page.

Availability varies. In Florida, plastic surgery is reserved in Miami; primary care is reserved in Miami, Hollywood, Fort Lauderdale, Orlando and Kissimmee; dentists are reserved in Miami, Coral Gables and Hollywood. Reserved practices can request a complimentary audit.

Choosing the right service

How Florida practices choose a specialty page and marketing service

Florida markets differ sharply. Miami-Dade is dense, bilingual and spread across many separate cities; Orlando and Tampa have their own patterns. Start with specialty, then location, then the actual service you need.

Specialty first

Specialty decides page types, clinical review needs and ad-policy limits.

Then city and ZIP

Territory commitments are set by ZIP code, and Miami-Dade contains many municipalities with separate identities.

Language support

Spanish pages make sense only when your staff can respond in Spanish. We plan content to match real support.

Compare honestly

Ask about scope, account ownership, fee versus ad spend, reporting and exit terms.

Specialty pages most relevant to Florida practices

  1. GastroenterologyMiami service
  2. CardiologyMiami service
  3. Plastic surgeryMiami audit only
  4. Primary careAudit only in Miami
  5. Urgent care and dentalExisting Florida pages

Services

Healthcare marketing services for Florida practices

Delivered remotely. We commit to the work and reporting; rankings, AI mentions and patient numbers are not guaranteed.

Website repair and technical SEO

Speed, errors, forms and structure fixed first.

Local SEO per office

Accurate profiles and pages for each Miami-Dade or Florida office.

Bilingual content where supported

Spanish pages reviewed by your bilingual staff and routed to people who can respond.

Physician and service pages

Built from your providers and services, approved by your clinicians.

Google Ads where offered

Campaigns for chosen services with ad-policy review.

Reporting

Calls, forms and referral actions by office, campaign and language.

See healthcare SEO and healthcare AI search optimization for detail.

Process and evidence

How remote service for Florida practices works

One practice contact, a shared task list, monthly video reviews and access you control. Our working hours overlap Eastern time.

  1. Check eligibility

    Specialty and every office ZIP code.

  2. Assess

    Website, listings, ads, tracking and language support.

  3. Prioritize

    Agree the order of work with your administrator.

  4. Build and improve

    Foundations, then content and campaigns.

  5. Measure and refine

    Monthly report and call.

Verifiable facts

What you can check about us

  • Operating since 2013 as WevTEC, a DBA of Bizzsol LLC, registered in Texas, based in Houston.
  • 1,000+ websites repaired; 500+ designed and redesigned.
  • Published Florida pages for Miami healthcare, Miami plastic surgery and Florida urgent care and dental SEO.

No Florida office, address or phone number is claimed.

Orlando also has limited availability in select specialties. A city not listed is not automatically open. Proposals are scope-based, with fees, ad spend and one-time work separated, and cancellable with 7 days’ notice. See our cost guide and the healthcare marketing hub.

Questions and consultation

Florida healthcare marketing questions

For practice owners and administrators in Florida.

How do we choose a healthcare marketing agency in Florida?

Compare specialty understanding, evidence you can verify, reporting, account ownership, fee versus ad-spend separation and exit terms. Ask whether the agency represents a competitor in your ZIP codes.

Can a Houston agency serve a Florida practice well?

For website, local search and ads work, yes, with clear access and regular video reviews. If you need frequent in-person meetings, a local agency may fit better.

How do you handle groups with offices in several Florida cities?

One page and one Google profile per office, consistent provider and service pages, and reporting by office. Each office ZIP is checked for availability.

Do you create Spanish-language content?

When your practice can support Spanish-speaking patients by phone and form, and a fluent staff member reviews it. Otherwise we advise against it.

What does reporting include?

Calls, forms and referral actions by office, campaign and language. We do not report call clicks as completed appointments.

How is pricing set?

Scope-based after review, with management fee, ad spend paid to Google, one-time work and optional services separated.

Which Florida cities do you cover?

Miami first. Other Florida cities on request, subject to the reservations listed above.
